fileHeader.description: Motion control per CiA 402 (IEC 61800-7 subset) + PLCopen MC API (IEC 61131-4 subset), fully self-contained in ST. Layer 1: AXIS402 drive model per axis (drive state machine SOD/RTSO/SO/OE/QSA/FRA/FA on control-word commands, Profile Position mode with trapezoidal profile and position servo loop: demand vs encoder feedback -> signed velocity command). Layer 2: MC_Power / MC_Reset / MC_Home / MC_MoveAbsolute / MC_MoveJog / MC_Stop with standard Execute/Done/Busy/Error interfaces driving the CiA 402 words. Layer 3: PLC_PRG application (enable, home, goto setpoint, jog, quick stop, fault injection + reset). No vendor motion kernel required.
